Position.lead: We believe technology should serve people. Every project we take on aims to make interactions between citizens and the state simpler, faster and more convenient.
Position.body: We build digital solutions that bring public services, business and modern technology together into a single, convenient ecosystem. Our goal is not just to automate processes, but to make them clear, reliable and accessible to every user.

development.title: Web and mobile development
development.description: Full-cycle digital product development: from requirements analysis and design to launch, technical support and further growth. We build web platforms and mobile apps for government organizations and commercial companies, taking on projects of any complexity and scale.
development.imageAlt: Laptop showing analytics dashboards and code

sms.title: SMS aggregator
sms.description: A platform for automated SMS messaging between companies and their customers. It delivers verification codes, service notifications and informational messages through the country’s mobile operators, helping businesses build reliable communication with their users.

payments.title: Payment system
payments.description: Payment infrastructure for settlements between citizens, businesses and government organizations. The system accepts and processes payments for public and commercial services, supporting settlements across online and offline channels.
payments.imageAlt: Paying for services with a smartphone at a payment terminal

cashRegisters.title: Unified cash register system
cashRegisters.description: A unified system that brings cash register services together in a shared digital infrastructure. It centralizes cash register operations, simplifies payment transactions and makes cash handling more transparent.
cashRegisters.imageAlt: Online cash register with a fiscal printer in a store

cashCollection.title: Cash collection
cashCollection.description: A full range of services for collecting, transporting and processing cash for businesses and organizations. Well-established security and control procedures keep operations reliable at every stage, from picking up the cash to delivering it to its destination.
cashCollection.imageAlt: Cash collectors receiving cash bags at an armored vehicle

accounting.title: Accounting consulting
accounting.description: Professional support for businesses in accounting, taxation and financial reporting. We help companies set up accounting processes, comply with legal requirements and make decisions based on reliable financial data.
accounting.imageAlt: Financial reports and analytics on a laptop

registration.title: Vehicle registration and inspection system
registration.description: We digitized vehicle registration and technical inspection at traffic police service points. By automating internal processes and simplifying paperwork, we made citizen service faster, more transparent and better organized. This has shortened queues and reduced the workload on staff.
registration.imageAlt: An AUTODOC employee carrying out a vehicle inspection

corridor.title: Red and green corridor
corridor.description: A visitor routing system for traffic police centers that speeds up service and reduces the workload on staff. Before the visit, the system checks for outstanding debts and directs the citizen to the appropriate route based on the results.
corridor.imageAlt: Routing terminal with red and green corridors at a traffic police center

dataCenter.title: Data center
dataCenter.description: A Tier III data center providing reliable infrastructure for hosting and processing data. It supplies computing power and storage to government organizations, banks, telecom operators, fintech companies and SaaS services. The infrastructure is built for fault tolerance, availability and data security.

lochinKoz.title: “Lochin Ko‘z”
lochinKoz.description: An AI-powered video analytics system that recognizes vehicles in traffic and checks their data against government databases. It helps detect violations, monitor compliance with obligations and make traffic enforcement more effective.
lochinKoz.imageAlt: An operator monitoring traffic video analytics

faceId.title: Face ID
faceId.description: Biometric identification and license plate recognition technology for digital services. It helps verify identities and identify vehicles, improving security and data reliability in the delivery of public services.
faceId.imageAlt: Terminal for facial biometric identification and license plate recognition

safeService.title: Safe Service
safeService.description: A super app that brings government and commercial services together in one place. Users get access to car services, public services and payments — from checking fines and buying insurance to paying for a wide range of services. A single interface simplifies everyday tasks and makes these services more convenient to use.

appeals.title: Electronic applications
appeals.description: A system that automatically generates electronic applications from citizens’ requests at traffic police offices. Moving requests to an electronic format simplifies paperwork and reduces paper-based document flow.
appeals.imageAlt: Online request to the traffic police on a laptop and smartphone

kiosks.title: Biometric info kiosks
kiosks.description: Self-service terminals for applying for and collecting driver’s licenses, ID cards and vehicle registration certificates. Biometric identification adds an extra layer of security, and the option of document delivery makes public services even more convenient.

registration.title: Digital vehicle registration and inspection system
registration.excerpt: covering the entire process — from data verification to paperwork..
body: A single digital platform automates vehicle registration, technical inspection and related services. The system covers the entire process — from data verification to document processing.
Thanks to integration with more than 15 government and commercial systems, the platform is already used by over 3 million people and handles more than 120,000 transactions a month.

eidGreeting.title: AUTODOC Holding leadership congratulates the team on Eid al-Adha
eidGreeting.excerpt: Sardor Shukhratovich prepared a warm and unusual video greeting for employees
body: On May 27, 2026, to mark Eid al-Adha (Qurbon Hayit), Sardor Shukhratovich, founder and chairman of AUTODOC Holding, prepared a warm and unusual video greeting for employees. Although he was abroad during the holidays, Sardor Shukhratovich recorded the video in advance to congratulate the team personally.

This once again reflects one of the key principles of AUTODOC Holding’s corporate culture: wherever you are, it is important to stay connected with employees and keep communication within the team constant. A strong team is united not only by shared goals, but also by mutual attention, respect and open communication. You can watch the video greeting at the link.

About.metaDescription: The history of AUTODOC Holding: from its founding in 2022 to a technology holding with more than 50 digital solutions for government and business.
About.title: The AUTODOC journey: from an idea to nationwide government projects

photos.openOffice: The Autodoc team in the office

founding.title: Company founded
founding.text: The company was founded on June 27, 2022. Its core focus was developing digital solutions to automate public services and simplify how citizens interact with government bodies.

firstProject.title: First project
firstProject.text: We developed an online application system for the Ministry of Internal Affairs and the traffic police, allowing citizens to submit requests and documents electronically without visiting government offices in person.

partnership.title: Public-private partnership
partnership.text: We signed a public-private partnership agreement with the Ministry of Internal Affairs to introduce digital solutions and develop modern services for citizens.

infrastructure.title: Infrastructure development
infrastructure.text: The holding entered a new stage, introducing advanced AI technologies across all key projects. The project portfolio grew to more than 50 solutions for the public and commercial sectors.

expansion.title: Expanding into new areas
expansion.text: The company began actively developing new digital services. Key projects were delivered, including SafeRoad and platforms for online applications and digital services for drivers.

holding.title: Forming the holding
holding.text: Building on its completed projects and accumulated experience, the company formed a technology holding that brings together companies and projects in digital services, intelligent systems and infrastructure solutions.
